name: AI Detector
description: Paste any text and get a verdict on whether it reads as human-written or AI-generated — using pure statistics, no AI involved. It scores sentence-length variety, buzzword density, transition-word habits and contraction use, scans for the invisible characters a Claude watermark is carried in, and paints every flagged stretch straight onto your text so you can see exactly what was caught. Find a watermark and the verdict names its author outright: generated by Claude. Nothing you paste leaves your device.
